name: analytics-history-responsive
goal: Keep every loop history field readable at desktop tablet and mobile widths

evidence: The loop table overflows its capture area, hiding columns on desktop and mobile. All fields should remain visible at each supported width.
The component catalog checked only overall page width, not its scrollable table. The existing history capture now asserts table fit and mobile field labels, with an active-loop state.
The committed desktop and mobile catalog assertions failed on harbor-mbp-2 because the table overflows its available width.
Wrap history table fields at wider widths and show labeled stacked fields on mobile.
The unchanged desktop and mobile catalog assertions passed on harbor-mbp-2 at the repair commit.
